newIssuerOwnedResolution.normalLayout: The current operator seat page, seat map, and facility outline publish 2,700 seats: 1F 1,544, 2F 576, and 3F 580; categories are 81 boxes, 2,411 general seats, 176 orchestra-pit seats, and 32 balcony-box seats.
newIssuerOwnedResolution.pitAndForestage: The operator publishes 2,524 seats with pit use. Its 1:100 stage-plan bundle states that using the orchestra pit and forestage reduces the audience by 176 seats, but no issuer-owned source maps those 176 seats to row and seat numbers. The seat page separately says some performances begin at row 6 without defining the relationship to that 176-seat reduction.
newIssuerOwnedResolution.wheelchair: The operator FAQ confirms a limited-capacity wheelchair space on 1F, the facility outline says wheelchair space is available, and the seat map displays an unnumbered wheelchair icon. No issuer-owned source publishes its capacity, inclusion in 2,700, or numbered seats removed or replaced.
newIssuerOwnedResolution.sourceDate: The live official seat page links the seat map (PDF metadata 2014-05-20; HTTP Last-Modified 2021-12-14). The live stage-drawings page links the 1:100 plan marked Ver.2016.03.01 and the 1:200 plan marked Ver.2014.01.11 (both HTTP Last-Modified 2021-12-21). Seat numbers/count use the live seat page/map as canonical; stage semantics prefer the later internal 1:100 revision. The older 1:200 plan is not mixed into seat-number mapping.
